name: Tellie

surfaces.surface_type: teleprompter HUD control bar (from marketing composite, not a window capture)
failures: #8 two saturated filled circles adjacent (orange play/pause + green listening) — soft Focal Collision
#10 dark circular buttons #1C1C1E ~1.3:1 on #080808 panel, shapes fall below 3:1 non-text floor
native #6 accent role bound to brand orange #FF8A00, not the user's system accent

tokens.notes: primary button + progress fill + eyebrow + icon body; substitutes for system accent
listening/ear indicator; exactly macOS system green (light)
dark-amber box behind the live word; the core feature made visible
reads as kit XL/toolbar tier; capsule/circle bezel matches macOS 27 capsule era

patterns.key_values: opaque near-black rounded HUD strip; left transport cluster (play/pause + restart + listening) | progress metadata + orange-filled slider with light-grey knob | reading cluster (speed label + A-/A+ + close); all controls circular; two saturated fills only
media-transport grammar (play/pause, restart, progress slider, time-remaining) borrowed wholesale for a teleprompter — Jakob's Law reuse

signature_moves: Brand orange #FF8A00 bound to the accent role everywhere (button, progress, word-highlight, icon) — deliberate substitution for the user's system accent
Single amber-boxed live word = the entire value proposition as one Von Restorff mark, doubling as the product demo
Notch-as-form-factor: teleprompter is a black rounded HUD evoking the MacBook notch; icon encodes a black notch cutout on an orange clipboard
Live 'ear' listening indicator (system-green circle + ear glyph) separate from transport — status colour correctly paired with a glyph
defects: Focal Collision (soft) — two saturated filled circles (orange action + green status) at equal circular weight blur the one-action read
UI-contrast (non-text <3:1) — dark button fill #1C1C1E ~1.3:1 on #080808 panel; shapes near-invisible, only white glyphs carry affordance
Non-native accent binding — accent is app-brand orange, never the user's system tint (recorded as a signature deviation, not sloppiness)

aesthetic.direction: Warm-utilitarian dark HUD with an editorial-serif brand voice — a Neo-grotesque-product app surface (near-black strip, one electric-warm accent, rounded controls) fronted by an Editorial/literary marketing display serif

psychology: Von Restorff / signal detection — the one amber-highlighted word is the single different thing; it captures attention pre-attentively and is the app's whole job
Zeigarnik & Goal-gradient — '13/24 words · 0:04 left' plus the progress slider nag at an incomplete script and accelerate effort toward the end
Jakob's Law — transport controls (play/pause, restart, progress, time-remaining) reuse the universal media-player schema, making a novel voice-following tool instantly legible
Fitts's Law — large ~36pt circular targets in a fixed HUD strip are fast to acquire
notes: CRITICAL for synthesis: the ONLY UI-bearing input is a 1200x630 OG-image marketing composite, not a screenshot. The large black panel is a stylised teleprompter surface and the serif headline is a marketing display face, NOT the app's reading font. Genuine app-chrome evidence is limited to the bottom control bar and the amber current-word highlight, and even the control bar may be a faithful mock. Lineage is unconfirmable (custom floating HUD, no window frame / traffic lights / sidebar / toolbar) so it reads 'unknown/low' and feeds NOTHING to macOS canon. Colours are crisp (hex marked measured) but their role assignment is inferred from a single surface. No settings, empty-state, onboarding, light-mode, or real-window evidence. First app profile in the corpus; corpus stays Novice on the app axis. Category is store-labelled 'Design' but the app is really a creator/presenter utility. Icon (orange clipboard-with-notch, big-sur-style raised bezel, highlighted script lines) digested only as brand evidence per Workflow-A-only scope; no icons/tellie.md written.
